title: Door, 11 rue Larrey (Open a Second Doorway)
summary: One door shared across two browser frames can never be shut in both — Duchamp's open-and-shut paradox, hinged onto the web.
mechanism: A local same-origin BroadcastChannel passes a single shared door state between two frames; focus claims the door (shut here, open there) with no server, storage, or network.
references: Alfred de Musset, Il faut qu'une porte soit ouverte ou fermee (1845)
